activities.name: Independent CS Research at IIT Bombay

rationale.intuition: Indian applicants face the deepest international penalty at MIT — the Indian intl pool is the largest and most over-represented STEM cohort. MIT EA admit rate is ~5% overall; Indian intl admit cluster 1-4% per published case data. Even with INMO top-30 + IIT lab research, profile sits in a saturated bucket. EA at MIT is non-restrictive (no boost vs RD for intl). Industry consensus: 1.5-7%.

sources.name: MIT CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 4.52%; intl ~10% of class, intl applicant pool dominated by India + China. Inferred Indian intl admit ~2-3%.

sources.name: Crimson Education India Acceptance Report 2024
sources.evidence: Indian applicants at MIT cluster at 1.5-5% across published RD/EA case data; STEM-spike Indian applicants face Asian over-representation penalty.

sources.name: IIE Open Doors 2024
sources.evidence: India is now the #1 country of origin for US international students (~330K); concentration in STEM amplifies bucket competition.
